title: Remote viewing Empress Himiko's palaces, temple and burial mountain
summary: Joe McMoneagle tells of Remote viewing Empress Himiko's palaces, temple and burial mountain, about c. 249 AD (viewing done later) at Japan (no place named), and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: existed and we think we believe that we found her her Summer Palace her Winter Palace her Temple her mother's Temple and her barri Mountain

plain: Joe McMoneagle, who says he was trained as a remote viewer, someone who tries to describe distant places or times using only the mind, says he used the method to look for traces of Himiko, an ancient empress of Japan. He says he and a group he calls Noai believe they found her summer palace, her winter palace, her temple, her mother's temple and the mountain where she was buried, and he points to old records of the royal court of China as support. If true, the mind could find lost history that digging has not.
